column1: # docs/provenance/REPLAY-MANIFEST.tsv — for `docs/ledger-tools/provenance_replay.py`.
# ⚠️ THIS IS NOT `MANIFEST.tsv`, AND THE TWO ANSWER DIFFERENT QUESTIONS.
#   MANIFEST.tsv  + verify.sh   (math)  — "are the bundle's files unaltered, and
#                                         does the program still match the blob
#                                         we pinned?"   Pins the CURRENT artifact.
#   REPLAY-MANIFEST.tsv         (this)  — "do the executor's logged tool calls
#                                         still REPRODUCE the artifact as born?"
#                                         Pins the BIRTH commit, forever.
# Both are wanted. Neither subsumes the other: a file can be byte-identical to a
# pin that was itself re-pinned after an edit, which is exactly the state S2
# bundle <TAB> target (absolute path AS THE EXECUTOR SAW IT) <TAB> git rev:path <TAB> source (optional)
#   python3 docs/ledger-tools/provenance_replay.py --manifest docs/provenance/REPLAY-MANIFEST.tsv
# ⛔ THE REV IS PINNED TO THE BIRTH COMMIT, AND MY FIRST VERSION OF THIS FILE HAD
# IT WRONG. At 13:2x I wrote "`--against HEAD:…` is deliberate, not a pin — a
# pinned rev would pass forever while the artifact drifted." That reasoning is
# right for a FROZEN artifact and wrong for a LIVE MODULE. At 14:0x math added
# 841 lines of S3(b) to `Program.lean`; the drift was legitimate development, and
# HEAD-anchoring turned a birth record into a permanent RED. A gate that goes red
# for expected behaviour is a gate someone switches off.
# A birth record binds a BIRTH. Pinning `bf2de34` makes the replay claim -- "the
# executor's tool calls reproduce this file exactly" -- true and checkable
# forever. Drift of HEAD away from birth is normal and is verify.sh's question,
# not this one.
# S2 — the bitonic sort. Born bf2de34; bundle a5d2ef7 (the next commit).
